{{Quote|I give away money because I enjoy making people happy. What do you think I would do? I am a bounty officer. I post and redeem bounties.|Stren Colo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:I" />}}
'''Stren Colo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Listen, these are local bounties, the small stuff. Some work crews want pesky creature killed or somebody is cheated at sabacc and wants a discount hit... they come here. For a real bounty, go find a Galaxy BH terminal.|Stren Colo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:I" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was stationed in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Colo worked at the [[Kachirho Starport]] as an Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] officer; his job was to post and redeem bounties.<ref name="SWG:I" />

During that time, he was contacted by the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Tien Wallub]] who placed a bounty on a the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Jessk]] who had been catch cheating at [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="SWG:I" /> In the meantime, [[Belga Daeri]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] official, placed a bounty on [[Dorn Nareusu]], a [[Asteroid Bandits|pirate]] who had destroyed several [[Transport/Legends|transport ships]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG:BD">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Belga Daeri|Kashyyyk}}</ref> Jessk was later shot down on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="SWG:JtT">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Jessk the Trandoshan|Kashyyyk}}</ref> while Dorn Nareusu was killed in a space battle above Kashyyyk.<ref name="SWG:DA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Dorn's arrival|Kashyyyk system}}</ref> Stren Colo eventually rewarded the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] for their work, 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Jessk the Trandoshan<ref name="SWG:JtT" /> and 10,000 credits for Dorn Nareusu the Human.<ref name="SWG:DA" />

Around the same time, a strange disease afflicted a number of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] around Kachirho. The illness gave rise to a madness which compelled the anguished Wookiees to attack anyone who approached them. As these Wookiees began to become dangerous, the Galactic Empire issued bounties for the insane Wookiees. A woman concerned by the situation named [[Sera Jossi]] therefore encouraged a number of spacers to hunt crazy Wookiees and claim the Imperial bounties. The spacers returned the mad Wookiee teeth as proof of the deed and Stren Colo rewarded 1000 credits per wookiee destroyed.<ref name="SWG:DtCW">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Destroy the Crazy Wookiees|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Stren Colo appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:I" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Stren Colo was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:I" />
